topic.title: Tip Calculator
topic.description: Calculates how much each person should pay including a chosen tip percentage. Practices float arithmetic, rounding, and formatted output.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Converting input to float, dividing bills, and rounding to two decimal places using round().
learningNotes.challenges: Handling floating-point precision and displaying clean output.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add custom rounding and support for unequal splits.

files.description: Bill and tip splitter among multiple people.
